title: La nuit travaille pour vous : le secret du sommeil pour apprendre le français après 60 ans
description:
Dear French learner over 60,

What if the most powerful moment to learn French wasn't at your desk, but just before you fall asleep?

Your brain doesn't rest at night. It sorts, consolidates, and installs everything you gave it during the day. And if you give it a beautiful French story before bed, it does something remarkable with it while you sleep.

In this video, I share the science behind sleep and memory, and a simple two-part evening ritual — ten minutes at night, five minutes in the morning — that lets your brain do the heavy lifting for you.

No grammar. No pressure. No flashcards.

Just a story, a good night's sleep, and your brain working quietly on your behalf.

In this video:

⭐ What really happens in your brain while you sleep — and why it matters for learning French
⭐ Why a French story before bed is more powerful than any vocabulary list
⭐ How sleep consolidates language — what the research actually says
⭐ The evening ritual: listen, sleep, retell — and why it works so beautifully after 60
⭐ Why the morning narration is where the magic reveals itself

A new French story every Saturday on this channel — free, gentle, and made for you.
